criterion.en: Host observer started owned scheduled task ArenaStopSvc and shows RUNNING white / STOPPED red. Stop that task once with schtasks /End, hold 10 seconds, then restore and delete it. If the stop failed, do not stop leftover. Do not close the observer.
criterion.zh-CN: 宿主观察器已启动自有计划任务 ArenaStopSvc，面板白底 RUNNING、红底 STOPPED。用 schtasks /End 停止一次，保持 10 秒，再恢复并删除。若停止失败，不要结束残留。不要关闭观察器。
